decisions.rationale: No session tokens; each CLI request includes fresh TOTP code. MTM stores TOTP secret encrypted, passes to adapter via stdin. Adapter validates on every CLI request. MTM validates on control messages.
Per-adapter control socket with 0600 perms; SO_PEERCRED verification

decisions.decision: Adapter validates session_token only (not separate cli_2fa_token)
decisions.rationale: MTM already verified TOTP before spawning; adapter trust boundary established at spawn

decisions.decision: Credentials via stdin and zeroization after VPN login
decisions.rationale: Avoid /proc exposure; minimize credential lifetime in memory
